preregistered_questions: Can cumulative opponent life loss from Loyal Subordinate pay for consecutive Aggravated Assault activations through Neheb postcombat triggers?
Which interruption windows stop the engine, and which already-triggered abilities survive source removal?
Does lieutenant require Abaddon at both beginning of combat and trigger resolution?
Is five red / {3}{R}{R} precisely the repeat-payment threshold, and does Neheb only generate red after a postcombat main phase begins?
assumptions: Exactly three opponents at 40 life, no attackers or combat damage unless explicitly injected
All four permanents are already in play; starting probability and commander casting are NOT modeled
Explicit scripted response windows only; no opponent stochastic strategy, no multiplayer win-rate inference
Neheb trigger computes cumulative opponent life loss at resolution and produces red, no priority shortcut
Aggravated Assault requires a controller's main phase with empty stack and {3}{R}{R}; follows with extra combat and a postcombat main
Loyal Subordinate's intervening-if commander requirement checked at trigger and resolution; its established trigger persists through subordinate removal
Unspent mana is cleared between steps/phases per rules; no unrelated spell, equipment, land, or card access effects are included
Life-loss prevention is distinct from damage fogs
required_outputs: Executable adversarial deterministic assertions with phase, priority and mana accounting
Independent scenario summary stating only conditional rule/payability truth, not deck improvement
CI at exact pull-request head; canonical deck SHA and approvals unchanged
not_claimed: Final superiority of Aggravated Assault over Rakdos
